inventory_title: Apple iOS 26.6 published security CVE extraction

source.title: About the security content of iOS 26.6 and iPadOS 26.6
source.scope_note: CVE identifiers transcribed from the official Apple advisory text reviewed for this commit. IDs are deduplicated; this inventory records what Apple published, not affected-version proof for the target.

limitations: This file is a deduplicated CVE-ID extraction from the reviewed advisory text, not a full record of each entry's component, impact, and fix.

Apple advisories may be updated after initial publication; the advisory includes entries added or updated later, so this is the page's currently visible set rather than a historical snapshot at the release date.

The extraction is not certified exhaustive yet: the page has additional sections and some ranges were not fully captured in the current review. Do not use the count as a final total until automated page-level comparison is complete.
A CVE listed as fixed in iOS 26.6 is not a known-unpatched lead on target iOS 26.6.1.
This data does not establish target applicability, exploitability, or a Freedom27 exploit chain.
